narrative:
Morrow County has 24,080 registered voters, with 50.4% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 38.3% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 11.2%, a pronounced Republican lean of 27.1 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 29.3% of registrants.
